summary.oneLiner: India's largest new-age end-to-end horizontal e-commerce enablement platform by revenue from operations in Fiscal 2026 (per the Redseer Report), an asset-light API-led software layer that lets MSMEs and Large Retailers ship, check out, get paid, fulfil and export.

currentContext.expansion: Shiprocket has no manufacturing footprint - the model is explicitly asset-light, with no owned delivery fleets and no owned fulfilment centres. Physical expansion is therefore leasehold and network-shaped: 13 leased fulfilment centres across 10 cities plus warehouse-management mandates at 5 customer-owned fulfilment centres and 11 third-party-operated warehouses as of March 31, 2026; eight regional offices, with new regional offices planned in Western and Southern India to reach Tier 2 and Tier 3 Merchants in person.
